stories.title: Granddad, McConaughey and Arch Manning's dealings with fame
stories.summary: The Texas quarterback has been a name since he started high school. His also-famous grandfather had a little more time to adjust to the spotlight.

stories.title: Ohio State says it wasn't 'battle tested' before. That's about to change
stories.summary: The Buckeyes bowed out of the playoff early last year and some pointed to a weak schedule as the problem.

stories.title: Source: Cardinals' Love expected to play Sunday
stories.summary: Cardinals rookie running back, after battling a high ankle sprain since mid-August, is expected to play Sunday against the Chargers, a source told ESPN.

stories.title: Sources: Suns' Williams has shoulder surgery, to miss extended time
stories.summary: Suns center Mark Williams had surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, sources told ESPN's Shams Charania.

stories.title: 'Gonna let them do them': Cunningham ignoring Kanter Freedom, White
stories.summary: Sophie Cunningham said she's focusing on the Fever's remaining games and not the commotion around Enes Kanter Freedom and Royce White declaring for the WNBA draft.
